content:
After first three verses, 45 singers have sung, leaving 15.

Fourth verse: \( \frac{1}{5} \times 15 = 3 \) join, leaving \(15 - 3 = 12\).

The 5 late arrivals already joined in the fourth verse, so they are not part of the fifth-verse joiners.

Thus, the number who joined in the fifth verse is \(\boxed{12}\).
